# quarto_temple_brand

**Status:** Public. **License:** dual `GPL-3 | MIT` for code/config (via `LICENSE-MIT`/`LICENSE-GPL-3` — no `DESCRIPTION` to hold a license field, since this is a Quarto extension, not an R package). The Temple name/logo are **not** covered by that license — see `README.md`'s License section.

## Ecosystem position

Part of Temple CBE's public layer, alongside `TempleCBE`, `pslongSim`, `omop-duck-db`, and `ML-PScore`. Consumed by `kyle_out_zip` (privately) and any Quarto project wanting Temple's brand config.

## Where it's heading

See `NOTES.md`. The `TempleCBE` scope boundary is settled: this repo owns what Quarto reads (brand, logo, `temple-*` formats, title page); `TempleCBE` owns the R side (brand palette and ggplot2 scales, `use_temple_brand()`, report scaffolding and rendering).
